createHint: Name your blog and start writing. Only explicitly selected articles and images can be published.
name: Blog name
fieldsHint: Only mapped fields and explicitly selected images enter the public copy. Authors show names only; related records and other fields stay private.
pending: Unpublished changes. Editing source content does not update the public copy. Rebuild and publish explicitly.
upToDate: The current published copy is online.
unsaved: Unsaved configuration. Save before building a preview.
discardDraftDescription: Load the latest saved blog configuration and discard these unsaved settings. You can copy the draft first.
draftCopyFailed: Could not copy the draft. Keep it open and try again.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Please copy the link manually.
selectionHint: Choose up to 20 articles for publication. Saving drafts stays private; select each image explicitly.
noDocument: Open the article to start writing.
assetsHint: Select each image explicitly. Unselected body images are omitted; covers must belong to the mapped file field.
noSources: This table has no articles yet.
recallHint: Recall invalidates old versions, URLs and previews. Other articles keep their published copies. Copies already downloaded by visitors cannot be recalled. Withdraw articles or unpublish their blog before deleting source records or tables.
previewHint: This is a 10-minute share preview. Anyone holding the link can read the selected content. It is excluded from search indexes and can be revoked. Publishing or recalling invalidates old previews.
buildHint: Save, build a static preview, review articles and images, then publish explicitly.
limits: Up to 20 articles, 60 images, 30 MiB of images per site; 5 MiB per PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF image. Generated HTML up to 4 MiB, 10 articles per page. Up to 100 regular internal versions including configurations; recall versions are exempt. RSS and sitemap are not provided.
historyHint: Restore creates a draft configuration without changing publication. Article properties and documents use current source versions on rebuild. Internal history and images remain until the site is deleted.
publishHint: Make this build’s explicit articles, fields and image copies public. Visitors need no account. Later source edits will not automatically change the public copy.
grantsHint: Separate grants for blogs from this content table. Build permission reads and copies selected content. Publishing makes content public and is never inherited from table or document permissions.

errors.REQUEST_FAILED: Request failed. Reload and try again.
errors.BAD_INPUT: Check field mappings, titles, unique URL slugs and selected images.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The blog, source article or file is missing or inaccessible. Reload to continue.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this blog operation.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: The draft or published version changed. Reload before continuing.
errors.SOURCE_CHANGED: Source content changed or is still public. Rebuild; recall articles before deleting sources.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH: This retry identifier belongs to another request. Reload and try again.
errors.LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The blog exceeds its count or size limit. Reduce articles or images, or create another site.
errors.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Image or publication storage is unavailable. The public copy is unchanged; retry this build.
errors.PUBLICATION_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: Publication approval expired or does not match. Confirm this operation again.
errors.UNPUBLISH_REQUIRED: Unpublish the site in the blog editor before deleting it.

bindExisting: Advanced: bind an existing content table
